conditional_low_observations.title: Cross-process concurrency can lose local state or audit updates
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: Repository, media and backup mutation paths now use a cooperative exclusive lock file in addition to in-process coordination, with bounded retries and fail-closed acquisition.
conditional_low_observations.condition: The original one-process gap is mitigated for cooperating local processes. Residual risk remains because this is a local-filesystem protocol, not a distributed lock, and stale locks are not auto-removed.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Keep all local writers on the same cooperative protocol; use a transactional datastore or distributed lease with explicit recovery before multi-host or production use.

conditional_low_observations.title: Path validation has residual symlink/reparse-point and TOCTOU exposure
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: Existing-path symlinks are rejected, stable reads compare pre/post state, and publication-candidate reads compare the opened handle identity and file state.
conditional_low_observations.condition: Residual risk remains under a hostile local filesystem because backup, persistence and media operations are not uniformly handle-relative/no-follow and reparse/TOCTOU behaviour was not dynamically reproduced.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Reject reparse points and use handle-relative or no-follow operations with post-open identity checks.

conditional_low_observations.title: Local editor responses can expose internal evidence references
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: Workbench editor DTOs remove verification and rights references plus media hash, storage key and audit events; administrators retain the full internal record by design.
conditional_low_observations.condition: Residual risk remains if another adapter exposes the repository's full internal records without applying the same role projection.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Keep role-specific projection at every adapter boundary and test that future editor/read responses suppress internal evidence fields.

conditional_low_observations.title: Release media URL validation is weaker than publication-candidate validation
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: The general release validator and publication candidate share isSafePublicMediaUrl; the candidate additionally rejects known local-only path prefixes.
conditional_low_observations.condition: Residual risk remains if a release path bypasses the candidate boundary because the general validator still accepts root-relative paths that only the candidate classifies as local-only.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Make the candidate exporter mandatory or move the local-only prefix rejection into the shared final-release policy.

conditional_low_observations.title: Some metadata reads and aggregate backup sizes lack explicit caps
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: Metadata is capped at 256 KiB; backups cap individual files at 128 MiB, aggregate bytes at 768 MiB and entries at 10,000, with local tests covering oversized metadata and aggregate restore budgets.
conditional_low_observations.condition: The original unbounded local conditions are mitigated; the static budgets and whole-file reads are development/test controls, not a production capacity or streaming design.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Preserve and tune these limits for the frozen local snapshot; design streaming and operational quotas separately if a production media/backup service is introduced.

conditional_low_observations.title: Local bearer tokens accept printable 32-character values and requests are not throttled
conditional_low_observations.current_evidence: Tokens now require a 43-128 character base64url-like form with character diversity, are stored as SHA-256 digests and compared with timingSafeEqual; loopback-only binding remains enforced.
conditional_low_observations.condition: Residual risk remains because token generation and rotation are not enforced and authentication attempts are not throttled; exposure rises if the local service is proxied or shared.
conditional_low_observations.remediation: Generate and rotate high-entropy tokens and add attempt throttling before any use beyond a trusted loopback workstation.
